producer_report.summary: I took the revert fallback. The cause of the 0 sccache hits was not reproduced, so I removed sccache from athena.toml. I could not run `sccache --show-stats` with the permitted commands, so no hit or miss counts were measured. The user's figures (0 hits, 644+ misses, 165-190s test check) are reports only. I removed `[tools.sccache]` and the RUSTC_WRAPPER, SCCACHE_DIR and CARGO_INCREMENTAL lines from both the change and study env tables. D46's per-job CARGO_TARGET_DIR and CARGO_TERM_COLOR stay. In config.rs the two sccache tests are rewritten. One checks that athena.toml has no pin and that the optional pin table still parses (a digest field is still rejected). The other checks that neither env sets any of the three keys. The setup code for an optional pin is unchanged. I added decision D84 (reverses D80, says the diagnosis was not reproduced and why), a CHANGELOG entry and a roadmap RM-0 item 1 outcome. The README now says athena.toml pins no sccache and `--ci` skips any pinned one.

checks_run.note: All suites reported ok, 0 failed. I ran this with --quiet so I could read the output; the check Athena runs is plain `cargo test --locked`.

open_issues: The real cause of the 0 hits is unknown. Candidates, as hypotheses only: per-job absolute paths changing keys, the CARGO_HOME or HOME registry paths, and the sccache server being blocked from starting or from using SCCACHE_DIR. Someone with shell access needs to measure `sccache --show-stats` over two builds.
RM-0 'done when' item 1 (a nonzero hit count) is not met. The roadmap records the outcome as a revert.
Builds are cold again, so the test check will stay slow.
mistakes: My first full `cargo test` run produced output too large to read. I reran with --quiet.
I tried to Grep the persisted tool-output file outside the working directory. The hook denied it.
learnings: Misses rather than failed builds suggest the wrapper binary was installed and ran. That is an inference; I did not observe it.
setup.sh and docs/enforcement.md contain no sccache text, so they needed no change.
xtask's `install_sccache` already skips when no pin exists, so no code change was needed there. The skip message is still accurate.
The env.rs tests use synthetic values, so they do not depend on athena.toml and needed no change.
desires: Permission to run `sccache --show-stats` and a build twice, so the cause could be measured.
Read access to cargo's persisted test output. A Grep on it was denied, so I reran the tests with --quiet.
